run_LuminaPipeline: run the LuminaPipeline to generate images from text prompts using a Gemma text encoder and transformer model
run_retrieve_timesteps: run retrieve_timesteps to get a scheduler timestep schedule from num_inference_steps, custom timesteps, or custom sigmas
run_LuminaPipeline_encode_prompt: run LuminaPipeline.encode_prompt to encode text prompts into Gemma hidden state embeddings with optional classifier-free guidance
run_LuminaPipeline_prepare_latents: run LuminaPipeline.prepare_latents to generate random latent tensors of the correct shape for diffusion denoising
run_LuminaPipeline__text_preprocessing: run LuminaPipeline._text_preprocessing to clean and normalize caption text with optional BeautifulSoup and ftfy processing
